title: Brewser app manifest
description: Canonical shape of every per-app manifest.json in the staging repo. Generated server-side by the Brewser Submissions plugin and validated in the staging workflow. Kept in sync manually — the plugin's Brewser_Sub_Manifest::build() is the generator and TEST_PLAN.md asserts its output validates against this file.

genre.description: Optional brewser_genre taxonomy terms mirrored from the submission.

features.description: Optional brewser_feature taxonomy terms mirrored from the submission.

tags.description: Optional free post tags mirrored from the submission.

publishedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC first-go-live timestamp. SET-ONCE: Brewser_Sub_Manifest::build() must carry any existing value forward unchanged on every rebuild — a resubmission must never alter this date (it drives the runtime's Most Recent sort). Mirrors the App Post's post_date, the same field the [brewser_browse] Most Recent tab orders on.

buttonMapping.description: Optional keyboard-key -> Switch-control map emitted by Brewser_Sub_Manifest::build(). Keys are lowercase keyboard key names, values are Switch control names; both sides come from a curated but FILTERABLE vocab, so this is a free-form string->string map (not an enum) to keep lockstep. Max 64 entries.

linked_idea_ids.description: Optional Brewser Ideas (Phase 2) build-linking: unique positive idea ids this app satisfies.
